name: patch-kinds
title: ctx.Patches: prefix, postfix and finalizer on one live site, and RemoveAll removed=3

steps.note: WARNING, and the reason this case runs LAST in -Case all: '.patchdemo on' pins the Sample plugin's ALC for the rest of the process (docs/bridge-ops.md, the .patchdemo row). The Sample can still be reloaded, but the old generation will not collect until the server restarts. Run this case when that is acceptable.

Evidence 208 (J14): '.patchdemo on' landed prefix, postfix and finalizer on ProjectM.ServerChatUtils::SendSystemMessageToClient; every chat reply fires all three in lockstep; '.patchdemo off' logged three unpatch lines and 'RemoveAll removed=3' (dev-loop.md had said 1, from the old single prefix).
Known state first: an 'off' with nothing armed replies that there was nothing to remove.

steps.expectLog: patches: prefix ProjectM\.ServerChatUtils::SendSystemMessageToClient.*owner=progenitor\.sample path=\S+ offset=\S+ priority=\d+ id=\d+

steps.note: '.patchdemo ping' calls the patched helper once, so all three kinds must fire for it.

steps.expectLog: Sample patchdemo: prefix fired on ProjectM\.ServerChatUtils::SendSystemMessageToClient.* fires=\d+
Sample patchdemo: postfix ran after ProjectM\.ServerChatUtils::SendSystemMessageToClient.* postfix=\d+
Sample patchdemo: finalizer ran after a clean return from ProjectM\.ServerChatUtils::SendSystemMessageToClient.* finalizer=\d+

steps.note: Two RemoveAll lines, one from each side. The Sample prints what ctx.Patches.RemoveAll() returned; Core prints the registry's own line. 'removed=3' is what the code decides and is asserted exactly. 'left' is NOT: it is the whole registry's remaining count, every other owner included — evidence at logs 1519 read 'left=4' (Core's epoch postfix plus the three kill prefixes), and the count moves with whatever Core and other plugins have armed. The first version of this case asserted 'left=0', copied from docs/dev-loop.md rather than from a log, and failed on a clean server.

steps.expectNoLog: patches: (apply failed|apply sweep FAILED|unpatch FAILED|group rollback FAILED)
